summary: Frontend mobile validation reached dashboard and found a blocking Ask SAI modal usability issue.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844, after opening Ask SAI and entering a question, the Ask SAI submit button is rendered below the viewport and cannot be tapped; Playwright reports Element is outside of the viewport. The modal card has maxHeight but no ScrollView/keyboard-aware handling.

action_items: Wrap Ask SAI modal content in a scrollable/keyboard-aware container or adjust bottom-sheet layout so input and submit remain tappable at 390x844.
Add testID attributes to remaining navigation, module, lead, inbox, and action controls for robust regression testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in .env while the stated contract references EXPO_BACKEND_URL; this is currently harmless because all data is local demo seed data, but should be aligned before live API integration.
Many Pressable controls have no testID despite the design/testing requirement for interactive elements.
seed_data_creation: None; deterministic seeded demo data only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390x844 preview loaded successfully; dashboard showed SIMULATED DATA and no horizontal overflow. Ask SAI opens, but its submit button is outside viewport after typing.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open preview at 390x844 -> tap Ask SAI -> fill question -> tap [data-testid=ask-submit]. Root cause is modalCard maxHeight: 88% combined with non-scrollable modal content and keyboard/autofocus; the submit Pressable is below the visible bottom sheet.
